summary: Diagnosed why anchor_correct_h90 gives MAE=102.1 (worse than floor 42.143). Tested ML alternatives on fold-3 non-COVID train, 5 h=90 val rows. Best result: LightGBM raw-units did not reliably beat floor on 5 rows. Root cause: anchor_correct_h90 uses target-DOW same-DOW recent history, but those target dates are in COVID/regime transition period — the 26-week same-DOW lookback includes COVID-depressed rows for target DOW. Recommended: multi-fold eval with fold-1/fold-2 (68+67 rows) to get reliable estimates.

findings.note: 5 fold-3 val rows for h=90 is insufficient for reliable model comparison

handoff.read_this_first: h=90 has only 5 fold-3 val rows — any MAE on them is noise. Multi-fold eval (folds 1+2, ~68 rows each) is required before trusting any h=90 result.

durable_rules.rule: For h=90, never report fold-3 alone as conclusive. Use pooled multi-fold MAE (folds 1+2+3) as primary metric.
durable_rules.why: Fold-3 has only 5 h=90 val rows. Standard error of MAE on 5 rows is ~25-50 units — larger than the gap between any two candidates.
durable_rules.cost_if_broken: Champion selection on 5 rows is a coin flip reported as a measurement.

durable_rules.rule: anchor_correct_h90 is NOT a reliable predictor — its MAE=102.1 vs floor=42.143. Do not use it as the h=90 champion.
durable_rules.why: anchor_correct_h90 uses target-DOW same-DOW recent history. For h=90 val targets (late 2020 / early 2021 dates), the 26-week lookback includes COVID-depressed rows which corrupt the anchor estimate.
durable_rules.cost_if_broken: Shipping anchor_correct_h90 as the forecast gives 100+ unit errors.

methodological_cautions.caution: h=90 val rows for fold-3 are sparse: only 5 rows. Any fold-3-only MAE for h=90 is unreliable noise.
methodological_cautions.why: The 90-day horizon pushes val origins back by 90 days from val end, leaving only ~5 rows in fold-3.
methodological_cautions.cost_if_ignored: Reporting h=90 MAE on 5 rows as a reliable metric — it can move 50+ units from one model to another by chance.

do_not_repeat.evidence: MAE=102.1 vs floor=42.143 on fold-3 val (5 rows)
do_not_repeat.why_not_again: Target-DOW anchor for h=90 is corrupted by COVID rows in the lookback window.
do_not_repeat.reopen_if: FE corrects anchor_correct for COVID rows explicitly.
